prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 4:5 grainy retro urban fashion portrait of an adult woman with long dark hair wearing a short-sleeve fitted white cropped top and a high-waisted pleated blue mini skirt. She stands at a slightly turned angle beside a worn wall covered in overlapping abstract poster and flyer shapes, resting one hand on the wall and showing a subtle curious playful side-angle expression. Keep the framing eye level to slightly elevated as a medium portrait, with the subject sharply focused and the wall softly blurred. Show wall creases and minor surface damage, but no readable text, logo, advertisement, or watermark. Use dim warm light, soft directional shadows, deliberate hazy soft focus, slightly desaturated vintage color, tactile grain and noise, and a nostalgic retro atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, low-angle body emphasis, provocative framing, readable text, logo, advertisement, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional approved-adult person, wardrobe, and poster-wall references may be attached. Preserve adult identity, white cropped top, blue pleated skirt, turned pose, worn poster-wall texture, warm dim light, and grain; replace all source poster typography with unreadable abstract graphic layers.
